title: Brown University shooting: two dead confirmed as students, as officials release footage of suspect – live updates
summary: Suspect remain at large as Ivy League university tells students to shelter in place Full report: Multiple people shot at Brown University in Rhode Island, police say What we know so far about the Brown University shooting Police said no weapons were recovered from the scene and the last sighting of the suspect was him leaving the Hope Street side of the building on foot. Timothy O’Hara, a deputy police chief, told a press conference that the suspect is a “male dressed in black” who exited the complex at Brown University. Continue reading...
